partyBanter.authority: User-authorized travel banter, 2026-10-04; movable/resizable/minimize-expand controls requested 2026-10-09
partyBanter.rule: Nonmodal floating window. Existing complete artwork uses native NineRegionSprite borders: expanded 15/60/40/36; bar 15/60/8/8. Fixed edges and dialog symbol retain size; only center/edge strips extend. Header dragging, separate corner resizing, clipped scroll viewport and disjoint minimize/join/grip hitboxes. Minimize retains a movable 42-unit bar with Expand and Join. Local player geometry survives reopening and clamps on viewport changes. Mouse focus/restrictions exist only over the panel or during a held drag; keyboard and map time are untouched. Native/human acceptance remains required.

playerApproaches.rule: Reuse approved notable-generation art without changing any fixed pixel. Title and public request use its existing apertures; the two buttons occupy its status plate. No numerical neglect scores or private conversation content appear in the request.

structuredActionComposer.rule: Preserve the current composer geometry and ReignSerifDynamic face. Only the attached indivisible action segment renders white; ordinary speech remains gray. Native selection may render white over its selection highlight. Backspace/Delete/cut/replacement touching the segment cancels the complete attached draft and preserves untouched surrounding text.

runtimeAtlas.rule: Every registered overlay source hash and decoded RGBA region must be pixel-identical to the rebuilt runtime atlas.

portraitPolicy.sourceImageRule: Portrait source files remain byte-for-byte untouched rectangular imagery. They are centered and slightly oversized beneath the approved plate; they must never be rewritten, pre-masked, alpha-cut, tinted, padded, bordered, or baked with framing.
portraitPolicy.frameOverlayRule: Every registered circle, oval, or portrait rectangle is an opaque black-marble aperture plate above the portrait. Its exterior and corners conceal the source rectangle; only the exact declared aperture is transparent. Approved antique-gold linework remains topmost, while opaque inner backing disks and pale neutral or white seams are forbidden.
portraitPolicy.completePortraitCardRule: Every portrait-bearing card is one complete moving raster asset whose opaque plate, border, portrait frame, and true-alpha aperture are physically integrated. The unchanged portrait source is a sibling beneath that card. A generic rectangle combined with a separate ring, mask, or frame is forbidden, and a fixed shell must not retain a superseded portrait hole behind the card roster.

conversationActions.widgets: RichTextWidget in individual, party, castle, social-event and tavern-house chat transcripts
conversationActions.rule: User-approved action-only Cormorant Garamond Medium Italic variant, same size and primary body color as adjacent upright speech. No fixed-shell or geometry changes. Only generated span style=Action markup is permitted.

typography.rule: Fixed titles, section labels, and ornament-integrated captions are baked into the approved shell artwork. Only genuinely dynamic or state-dependent content remains live, and its typography must match the latest approved reference as closely as the Bannerlord/Gauntlet renderer permits.

canonicalBrush.selectionRule: Use DefaultText or Info.Text for the approved role behavior, but explicitly declare Brush.Font=ReignSerifDynamic on every remaining live TextWidget and EditableTextWidget. The alias is a module-local Cormorant Garamond Medium SDF font. Fixed shell lettering must not also exist as hidden or transparent runtime text.

fontPolicy.familyAndFace: Fixed shell lettering uses the exact approved raster pixels. Every genuinely dynamic or state-dependent live text widget explicitly declares Brush.Font=ReignSerifDynamic; DefaultText or Info.Text without that declaration is not sufficient and must fail acceptance.
fontPolicy.weight: Match the approved regular or emphasized weight without synthetic bold, glow, outline, or shadow unless that treatment is visibly present in the approved reference.
fontPolicy.capitalizationAndTracking: Preserve the approved capitalization, small-cap treatment, and deliberate letter spacing. Literal spaced capitals are permitted where Gauntlet exposes no tracking control.
fontPolicy.sizeAndHierarchy: Match each approved title, section heading, body, secondary, muted, button, caption, and numeric tier at the closest supported native font size.
fontPolicy.alignmentAndWrapping: Match approved horizontal and vertical alignment, baseline, line spacing, wrapping width, and truncation behavior.

textEffects.policy: No standalone approved reference uses synthetic outline, glow, blur, or shadow text effects. These attributes must be absent or numerically inactive.

acceptance.failurePolicy: An unexplained font, size hierarchy, alignment, tracking, weight, or text-color mismatch fails acceptance even when the text content itself is allowed to vary.

supportAssets.role: compact modal shell with transparent outside padding so the triggering interface remains visible
exact reusable lift of the actual modern lower Court button for Royal Proclamation and Chancellor controls

fidelity.registration: deterministic content-aware alignment with no freeform warp

nativeAcceptance.rule: Every fixed visual element in the native in-game interface must match the latest approved reference exactly after deterministic normalization and alignment.
fixedVisualElements: panel fills and lighter-grey raised or active surfaces
font family and face, weight, capitalization, tracking, size hierarchy, alignment, and frozen text-color roles
allowedDifferences: declared portrait or character imagery inside its approved aperture mask
declared banner or heraldry imagery inside its approved aperture mask
declared memory or scene artwork inside its approved aperture mask
protected map contents inside the approved War Council viewport
variable text, numeric values, list entries, and progress values
other scene-dependent graphics explicitly declared as dynamic and confined to an approved mask
forbiddenDifferences: unexplained or off-palette colors in a fixed region
missing, extra, displaced, or distorted fixed frames and ornaments
incorrect aperture shape, matte, or border
an opaque rectangular matte around a circle or oval portrait frame
a pale neutral, white, or silver halo around a circle or oval portrait frame
a portrait source file altered to bake in clipping, tint, framing, or background material
a portrait-bearing card assembled from a generic rectangle and a separate frame or mask
a superseded portrait aperture retained in a fixed shell behind a moving card roster
fixed-region texture, material, brightness, contrast, or opacity drift
unapproved font substitution, typography hierarchy drift, or off-palette text color
using dynamic-content variance to excuse a fixed-shell difference
nativeAcceptance.interactionStates: Each fixed hover, pressed, selected, focused, disabled, and error state must use its approved modern-style state tokens and geometry; state changes are not exemptions from fixed-visual parity.
nativeAcceptance.failurePolicy: Any forbidden fixed-region difference fails native acceptance and must be corrected before the interface can qualify as complete.

requiredEvidence: native fixed-region comparison with explicit dynamic-region masks and zero unexplained fixed-region differences

conversationOutfitChange.fullBodyFit: contain; never distort or crop head/feet

structuredActionBuilder.composition: One complete black-marble and antique-gold owning artwork; no separate decorative frames. Step choices scroll within a 680x200 viewport at 40px row pitch. Sentence scrolls within a 652x64 reading field. Back and Cancel remain visible. Only declared dynamic regions are masked for source-reference fidelity.

portraitRefresh.rule: Unchanged approved notable-generation shell; three independent choice hitboxes remain inside its status plate. Native acceptance pending.

partyChatAnnouncements.authority: User requested a matching Announce button immediately to the right of Send, using the current input and actual party-only audience. User also requested image capabilities for clean final artwork.
partyChatAnnouncements.rule: Announce sends the existing draft directly to the captured actual party roster; selected location NPCs do not define recipients. No immediate reply or normal conversation dispatch. Use the original single-button shell outside ordinary party chat.

announcementReading.authority: User request, 2026-10-15: give news and existing ruler-to-ruler diplomacy comfortable reading space.
announcementReading.rule: One vertically flowing, left-aligned report with paragraph separation and no text shortening or auto-shrinking. Headline, summary, terms and public ruler explanations share the same scroll viewport. Side captions contain only short roles. Full long reports must be reachable with the wheel and scrollbar while the acknowledge control remains available. Native acceptance required.

portraitFraming.authority: User correction, 2026-10-15: ruler portraits are too close and cut off the hair.
portraitFraming.source: Full uncropped zoom portrait and validated normalized face metadata; source and shipped derivatives remain intact.
portraitFraming.rule: Frame the original once, with the full head, hair and shoulder context inside the existing oval. No second square crop of the chest portrait; no stretching or new portrait files. Missing focus retains the original height from its top. Native fallback and framing acceptance remain required.

nativeFallback.rule: The original square native character portrait fits entirely inside the 143-wide aperture. Center it vertically to leave headroom beneath the oval crown; never enlarge it beyond the clipping width.

chatView.authority: User-requested View scene images, 2026-10-29; implementation review 2026-10-30
chatView.status: implemented using existing approved components; native and human acceptance pending
chatView.inlineImage: 3:2, centered, contained within complete approved memory aperture. Castle uses a compact 192x108 owning card to fit its 190px transcript. No source image is resampled for the enlarged view.
chatView.enlargedImage: Centered 1280x720 complete memory aperture with undistorted 941.25x627.5 scene; click or Escape closes.
chatView.caption: ReignSerifDynamic, 16px, textPrimary; compact castle caption is bounded to 96 display characters while archive retains complete caption.
chatView.conditionalControlMasks: Party uses two bounded Clear-identical controls registered in partyChatContinuation; individual/castle retain their existing approved View assets. Every conditional control is separately pixel/geometry checked.
chatView.proof: ChatViewTests, test-chat-view-contract.mjs, complete rendered preview matrix, fixed-shell fidelity; native acceptance deferred

partyChatContinuation.authority: User requested Continue below ALL and View identical to Clear centered below Clear.
partyChatContinuation.states: Identical owning art and geometry in idle/hover/pressed/disabled; sound-only behavioral brush matches Clear. Disabled live label uses disabledNeutral. No oversized legacy plate, eye icon or hitbox.

warCouncilMilitaryStanding.productionRule: Render complete generated image rectangles at uniform scale, with alpha transparency and live labels/selections. No clipping, image resampling, replacement map/shell/portraits, separate decorative overlays or per-row frames.

courtWorkspace.playerCustomScale: Independent fitted court layer; preserve base native HUD reservations. Explicit preview developer scale overrides remain available.
